#      POST https://godbolt.org/api/compiler/<id>/compile
# NOTE: CE runs Release builds and dxc_trunk is a rolling build, so this
#       corroborates the local Debug ground truth, it does not overrule it.

# SKILL.md step 7: "A Clang error is not evidence until you have a control."
# Clang's DXIL backend cannot lower a pixel shader, so it fails on inputs that
# have nothing to do with this issue. Required: the same shader with the
# CORRECT sampler type must NOT produce the overload error above.
#
# expect: no "no matching member function" error, and no conversion note.
# result: PASS -- Clang gets past Sema and fails later, in DXIL lowering, with
#         an unrelated error. So the conversion note above is a Sema result
#         about the sampler type, not an artefact of Clang's incompleteness.
#         The repro never reaches DXIL lowering, so this limitation does not
#         affect the pane.

clang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-Qembed_debug' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
error: Unsupported intrinsic llvm.dx.load.input.v2f32 for DXIL lowering
error: Unsupported intrinsic llvm.dx.store.output.v4f32 for DXIL lowering
2 errors generated.
